description: Answer evaluations for dispositional traits (Methods, 'Dispositional traits'). 'templates': 40 forced-choice prompts, each read in two orders (order 0: T adjective as {a}, E adjective as {b}; order 1: swapped). 'open': ten open questions. The answer evaluation records, at the first answer position, the log-likelihood of each adjective summed over its surface variants, exactly as for animal names (the same behaviour-evaluation module and placeholder rules: {a},{b} as given, {ap},{bp} with an 's' appended, {Ap} capitalized with 's' appended, {A1} capitalized). Answers are not sampled.
